Blogs

13 predictions for the future of the $3.4B social casino games market

Social casino games have become a huge industry in their own right. In this piece by Dean Takahashi, he interviews and gets a number of predictions about the future of casino games from Adam Krejcik. Krejcik is a part of Eilers Research, a group keeping a close eye on trends in the genre. The first prediction is the integration of skill play into social casino games.

What You’re Still Getting Wrong About App Store Optimization

App store optimization makes sure you get a return of investment on your app or game. Even if you’ve been around the block a few times before, check out this list to see if you’re really getting it right. Are you still keyword stuffing or using a trusted “hack”? Get out of the habit and make sure you’re getting your money’s worth from the app stores.

Game Development 101: Advertising Your Game

As part of an ongoing series, Black Shell Media have turned their attention to advertising. How are you advertising your game? The guys say you need to be patient and persistent but the results can have long-term benefits. Advertising will help you build a reputation and bring you new users.

Quality Assurance: An Untapped Resource for Mobile Game Developers

Quality Assurance may have gone by the wayside for smaller studios nowadays. Which is a pity because it can be a great way to find initial glitches and bugs in your project. This guide lists the different options available to all levels of developers and how you can implement a quality assurance strategy.

“People in 2017 will look back and say we had it easy”

Machine Zone CEO, Gabriel Leydon, has made some very stark predictions about the future of the mobile game industry. His predictions can be boiled down to there being larger studios, fewer game releases, and poorer receptions for completely new titles. He’s also extremely pessimistic about how much development can be achieved in a year. He said, “I don’t think it’s possible to do five games a year. I’m not even sure it’s possible to do two”.

What to make of decreasing mobile CPMs in Asia

PubMatic, a developer of marketing automation software, carried out a survey of their users and discovered two interesting trends. First of all, monetized mobile impressions are increasing with iOS being the main benefactor. The second observation is the decrease of CPMs in large growth areas such as China.

News

Google details Android 6.0 requirements: Disk encryption by default, fingerprint sensors, and Doze

Google have updated their Compatibility Definition for device manufacturers wanting to use Android 6.0. Among the new requirements is full-disk encryption by default, Doze mode cannot be modified, and the exact requirements for fingerprint sensors are outlined. Doze mode will prevent manufacturers from playing with Marshmallow’s power management improvements.

82% of Brazilians 18-59 play games – NPD

The latest reports from the NDP Group suggest there’s still room to grow in one of the world’s largest emerging markets. The good news for mobile developers is Android smartphones are the second most popular common device for users. With 82% of the population already gaming, the NDP Group predict that there will be even more growth in the future.

Study Shows That Games Are Still Top Performers for iOS and Android Apps

Time spent playing games makes up the majority of mobile device usage according to adjust.com’s Q3 report for 2015. Users are supposed to be spending anywhere from 2-10 times more time playing games than using their mobile apps. Don’t get too invested in these figures though. The drawback of this study is that adjust.com only included figures from apps being tracked by their platform.
